Two panels: left NASA ISS photo of Red Sea coast labelled "ISS PHOTO - NOT THE NEOM SITE", credit NASA/ISS 30 Nov 2021; right Sentinel-2 NEOM area with 10 km scale bar. Supports C20 (Red Sea coast) without claiming the ISS photo is NEOM.
Card: BLOOMBERG - APRIL 2024; "About 2.4 km of The Line expected by 2030"; "Fewer than 300,000 residents by then". Matches C2 wording.
Card: SEMAFOR - 22 MAY 2026; "Work on The Line halted until at least after 2030"; "Unnamed sources. Not officially confirmed". Matches C3 and hedging.
Card: REUTERS - ABOUT 4 OCT 2026; "NEOM stadium shelved indefinitely"; "Two sources. No official announcement". Matches C4.
Process diagram: original article NOT OPENED BY US -> described by Outlet A/B -> who reported what, and nothing more. States our own method; no external claim.
Nearest-neighbour zoom of Sentinel-2 Oct 2026 showing visible 10 m pixels, title "One pixel = 10 m of ground", 100 m scale bar. Supports C15.
Two columns: CAN SEE long cleared strip, road; CANNOT SEE person, crane, window. Matches script wording about 10 m resolution (C15).
Seven year chips with scene dates 29 SEP-18 OCT, SAME ORBIT 78 pass about 08:08 UTC, SAME SEASON, CLOUD UNDER 0.1 PERCENT. Dates/orbit/cloud match stack provenance (C16).
Cards: near-infrared very low; NDWI above zero; 2024-2026 water-like; 2022-2023 no pixel qualifies; "fits water - not proof, a shadow can fool it". Matches C11 and the hedge.
Three dates 8 OCT 2024, 8 OCT 2025, 18 OCT 2026 mapped to Sentinel-2A/2B/2C; segment present in all three. Matches provenance and C14.
Side by side Sentinel-2 (10 m) vs Landsat 8 (30 m) Oct 2024 on the same coordinates, 1 km scale bars, 1.6 km vs 0.7 km. Dark segment visible in both. Supports C13.
Bar chart in km: S2 Oct 2024 1.60, L8 Oct 2024 0.72 highlighted, S2 Oct 2025 1.60, L8 Oct 2025 1.65, S2 Oct 2026 1.92, L8 Sep 2026 1.65. Values match ndwi.json and landsat_measure.json (C12, C13).
Three green checks (3 dates/3 satellites agree, Landsat sees it, present 2024-2026) and a red "LENGTH: 1.6 OR 1.9 KM? UNSETTLED". Matches C14, C13, C12 and the script conclusion.
Sentinel-2 Oct 2026 zoom, 2.5 km wide, callout DARK SEGMENT, 200 m scale bar; title says no building can be identified at 10 m. Limitation statement, no new claim.
Four limits: not a finished city; not that this corridor is The Line; no official NEOM map; a similar picture does not prove a pause. Mirrors script limits (L).
Landsat 8 panel (30 m, 22 Oct 2024): dark segment visible as a short dark streak, same coordinates as the Sentinel-2 panel, 1 km scale bar; supports C13 (shorter measured length, 0.7 km).
Seven year chips 2020-2026 with scene dates 29 SEP, 29 SEP, 9 OCT, 14 OCT, 8 OCT, 8 OCT, 18 OCT; match stack provenance datetimes (C16).
Three rows: SAME ORBIT 78 pass around 08:08 UTC, SAME SEASON 29 SEP to 18 OCT, CLOUD COVER UNDER 0.1 PERCENT; matches provenance (relative orbit 78, 08:07-08:09 UTC, cloud 0.03-0.05 percent) and C16.
Two red cards: THAT IT IS A FINISHED CITY; THAT THIS CORRIDOR IS THE LINE. Mirror the script limits (L).
NO OFFICIAL NEOM MAP TO MATCH IT AGAINST; A SIMILAR PICTURE IN 2025 AND 2026 DOES NOT PROVE A PAUSE. Mirror the script limits (L).
Landsat 8 22 Oct 2024 at 30 m, 6 km wide view, 1 km scale bar; callout dot sits on the short dark streak, text 'DARK SEGMENT: ABOUT 0.7 KM' matches C13. Image is hazy (real low contrast).
Two rows: SAME ORBIT 78 pass around 08:08 UTC; SAME SEASON 29 SEP TO 18 OCT. Matches stack provenance (relative orbit 78, 08:07-08:09 UTC, dates 29 Sep-18 Oct) and C16.

Big number 0.1 percent with caption 'is the ceiling for reported cloud cover in all seven scenes'; provenance cloud cover is 0.029-0.059 percent, so under 0.1 (C16). Source line states 0.03 to 0.06 percent.
Cards: near-infrared signal very low; water index NDWI above zero; 2024, 2025, 2026 water-like; red 'fits water - not proof, a shadow can fool it'. Matches C11 and its hedge.
Dates 8 OCT 2024, 8 OCT 2025, 18 OCT 2026; segment present in all three; Sentinel-2A, 2B, 2C. Matches provenance platforms/dates and C14.
Chain: SENTINEL-2 SATELLITES -> EUROPEAN COPERNICUS PROGRAM -> FREE, FULL AND OPEN DATA. Matches the script wording and the licence text in provenance (C16).

Rows: OCT 2024 8 and 22 Oct; OCT 2025 8 and 25 Oct; 2026 26 Sep and 18 Oct; red '2 to 3 weeks apart: resolution or timing? we cannot tell'. Dates match Sentinel-2 and Landsat provenance (14, 17, 22 days), C13.
Three blue questions (growth / different water level / where our threshold falls) and a red 'we do not claim that it grew, we cannot tell'. Mirrors C12 and the script.
